page_title: ARS 0-2 WHU | Arsenal v West Ham 28/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.

90+6' Said Benrahma (West Ham) fails to beat the goalkeeper from the penalty spot with a shot inside the right post. David Raya anticipates his intention perfectly, though, and leaps to stop his effort.
90+6' Said Benrahma (West Ham) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

90+5' Declan Rice (Arsenal) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Michael Oliver blows his whistle for an infringement. West Ham are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
90+2' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

90+2' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat. Arsenal will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

90+2' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Arsenal.
90+1' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) for his blatant foul.

90+1' Reiss Nelson (Arsenal) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
90+1' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.

90' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the right side of the goal. Alphonse Areola is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. Arsenal win a corner.

89' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) inside the box and he manages to steer it to the middle of the target. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Alphonse Areola makes a save in the nick of time and maintains the current score.
89' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
88' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Arsenal can continue in their attacking effort.
88' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
87' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
86' Chance! Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards goal, but Alphonse Areola is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
84' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for West Ham.
83' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. West Ham earn a corner.
83' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Arsenal as the referee indicates there was no infringement!
82' Referee Michael Oliver makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Arsenal. Let’s see what happens!
82' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
81' The total number of attempts is 22:5.
80' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) sends a long ball forward to Emile Smith Rowe, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
79' Today's match ends for Leandro Trossard who will be replaced by Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal).
79' Rough tackle by Said Benrahma (West Ham). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.

78' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Alphonse Areola pulls off an easy save.
76' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) was too forceful with his tackle and Michael Oliver interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

75' The opposition give Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) far too much space and he has a go from long range, but the goal isn't threatened as the ball goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
75' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

74' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Alphonse Areola is alert and denies him with a nice save. The referee signals a corner kick to Arsenal.
72' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Reiss Nelson (Arsenal) was quite harsh and Michael Oliver didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
72' Declan Rice (Arsenal) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from distance, but it's blocked.

70' Reiss Nelson (Arsenal) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick in order to find one of his teammates. His poor effort, however, sails way out of play. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
70' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Mohammed Kudus (West Ham). Michael Oliver saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. A free kick to Arsenal.
68' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) tries to find Bukayo Saka, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.

66' Ben White pings in a cross towards the edge of the six-yard box. Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) jumps highest but sends his header just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
65' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) rises above the defence and heads the ball low, into the middle of the goal. The keeper is there waiting and denies him.
64' The game has come to an end for Oleksandr Zinchenko. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Reiss Nelson (Arsenal).
64' Mikel Arteta has decided to substitute Gabriel Martinelli and he is replaced by Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal).
63' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
61' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
59' Flag up against Jarrod Bowen (West Ham). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.

58' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.

55' 0 - 2 James Ward-Prowse takes the set piece, sends a cross in and Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) leaps high to connect with it on the penalty spot. His towering header deflects into the top right corner off the post. The score changes to 0:2.
55' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) prepares to take a corner kick.

55' Emerson (West Ham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. West Ham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

53' Declan Rice (Arsenal) collects a wonderful lead pass and as he has a lot of space, smashes a terrific shot from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
53' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.

51' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
51' Ben White (Arsenal) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

49' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Leandro Trossard (Arsenal), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
49' There's an opportunity for Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
48' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal). The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Arsenal.
47' Arsenal hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
44' The corner from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is hurriedly cleared.

44' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot. The ball goes behind for a corner. West Ham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
43' Michael Oliver has a clear sight and sees a foul from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal).
42' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the right post. Unlucky!
41' A pass from Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) is intercepted by Alphonse Areola and the move breaks down.
40' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Michael Oliver blows for a foul.

37' Gabriel Jesus plays a lovely pass into Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.

35' Oleksandr Zinchenko looks up and plays a clever lofted ball onto the head of Ben White (Arsenal), who sends the ball narrowly wide of the left post from near the penalty spot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
34' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
34' A cross from Ben White (Arsenal) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Arsenal.
33' Lucas Paqueta is being substituted because of an injury. David Moyes sends Said Benrahma (West Ham) on the pitch.
32' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
31' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

30' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Alphonse Areola, who pulls off a stunning save! Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.
30' Ball possession – 71:29.
29' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
28' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Arsenal win a corner kick.
27' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) takes a short free kick.
26' The referee blows his whistle as James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) was too aggressive in his challenge. A free kick is awarded to Arsenal.
25' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
25' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but David Raya comes off his line to gather the ball.
22' Some patient build-up play from West Ham as they look to unlock the defence.
19' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
17' Michael Oliver sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
16' The goal for West Ham is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
13' 0 - 1 Goal! Jarrod Bowen provides Tomas Soucek (West Ham) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a strike into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
12' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) makes a strong challenge and Michael Oliver blows for a foul.

12' Gabriel Martinelli passes to Leandro Trossard (Arsenal), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.

10' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
9' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) brings an opponent down and Michael Oliver interrupts the game.
9' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
8' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Arsenal have a corner.
5' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.

4' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Alphonse Areola, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
3' The Arsenal players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
1' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! West Ham will take the kick-off.
Michael Oliver will officiate today.
